objectives_fil: Maipaliwanag at mailapat sa isang sitwasyon: maliit na hakbang sa pagpapabuti.
objectives_en: Explain and apply in a situation: one practical improvement.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ilarawan ang nakita o narinig; huwag sisihin ang tao o gawing tiyak ang hinala.
sections.takeaway_en: Describe what you saw or heard; do not blame people or treat an assumption as fact.

sections.takeaway_fil: Pumili ng maliit na unang hakbang na pag-uusapan, hindi ng pagbabagong ipapatupad nang mag-isa.
sections.takeaway_en: Choose a small first step to discuss, rather than a change to impose alone.

sections.takeaway_fil: Tiyakin ang kasalukuyang impormasyon at pahintulot sa tamang tao bago kumilos.
sections.takeaway_en: Confirm current information and permission with the right person before acting.

sections.takeaway_fil: Isang gawain, malinaw na pananagutan at pahintulot, kayang oras at gamit, at takdang pagbabalik.
sections.takeaway_en: One action, clear responsibility and agreement, feasible time and materials, and a review date.

sections.takeaway_fil: Tingnan ang maliit na palatandaan at feedback; baguhin ang plano ayon sa nakita.
sections.takeaway_en: Review a small indicator and feedback; adjust the plan based on what happened.

sections.takeaway_fil: Napansin → Tiniyak at napag-usapan → Maliit na plano → Sinubukan at binalikan.
sections.takeaway_en: Observed → Confirmed and discussed → Small plan → Tried and reviewed.

check.prompt_fil: Magkaiba ang sagot ng mga residente kung sino ang tatanungin sa health station. Aling plano ang dapat munang ihanda ni Vlanche?
check.prompt_en: Residents give different answers about whom to ask at the health station. Which plan should Vlanche prepare first?

options.fil: Gumawa ng paalalang may pangakong libre ang lahat ng serbisyo upang mahikayat ang mga residente.
options.en: Prepare a reminder promising every service is free to encourage residents.

options.fil: Tiyakin sa midwife ang contact at mensahe, magkasundo sa kayang pagbisita sa susunod na linggo at gamit, saka balikan sa Biyernes kung masabi ng mga nakausap ang contact at kung may tanong pa.
options.en: Confirm the contact and message with the midwife, agree on feasible visits next week and materials, then review on Friday whether people can name the contact and what questions remain.

options.fil: Palitan agad ang proseso ng health station at ipaalam na lamang ito sa midwife pagkatapos.
options.en: Change the health station process immediately and inform the midwife afterwards.

options.fil: Ipanukalang pagbutihin ang lahat ng gawain, saka na isipin kung sino, kailan, at paano susuriin.
options.en: Propose improving all activities and decide who, when, and how to review later.

check.feedback_fil: Ang ikalawang plano ang maisasagawa: may kumpirmadong impormasyon at pahintulot, maliit na gawain, kayang oras at gamit, at palatandaang babalikan. Walang batayan ang pangakong lahat ay libre; ang pagpapalit ng proseso nang mag-isa ay lampas sa napagkasunduan; ang “pagbutihin ang lahat” ay kulang sa konkretong hakbang.
check.feedback_en: The second plan is workable: it has confirmed information and agreement, a small action, feasible time and materials, and an indicator to review. The blanket free-service promise is unsupported; changing the process alone exceeds the agreement; “improve everything” lacks a concrete first step.

Input images: the two attached images are character identity and visual style references only, not edit targets. Create a NEW photorealistic educational scene of BHW Vlanche, the midwife, and Mang Ernesto planning one small next-week improvement around an unbranded wooden table in a modest Filipino barangay community room. Preserve their recognizable identities: Vlanche is a Filipina around 40 with short softly wavy black hair, teal polo and dark trousers; midwife has tied-back black hair and light blue scrubs; elderly Filipino Ernesto has gray hair and a cream collared shirt. Vlanche thoughtfully arranges THREE blank cream note cards, midwife calmly contributes with one open hand, Ernesto listens and asks a question. Natural anatomically correct hands, relaxed respectful expressions, warm daylight, lived-in Philippine surroundings. Frame all three faces and the table clearly with comfortable margin, landscape composition suited to contained mobile and desktop display. No readable text, no personal information, no logos, no official-looking forms or campaign material, no medical procedure, no benefit promise. Keep the reference's natural photographic warmth and skin tones, but use a distinct composition and planning action; do not recreate the primary-care encounter.
